title: CodeSense AI – AI Code Explainer for Beginners
description: Designed and built an AI-powered code companion that explains code line-by-line, detects bugs, suggests optimizations, and teaches programming concepts in Bangla. Built with a custom prompt-engineered AI core, an interactive 3D visual experience, and a real Monaco editor supporting 8+ languages.

title: MediMate Health Companion – AI Medication & Symptom Tracker
description: Built a full-stack AI-powered personal health platform that digitizes medication scheduling, symptom journaling, and proactive health insights. Features an AI symptom checker, adherence streak tracking, doctor-ready PDF report export, and HIPAA-aware Supabase authentication with a calm, responsive dashboard UI.

title: BAUST Tea Bar – Faculty Food & Tea Ordering Platform
description: Developed a secure, full-stack food and tea ordering and service management system built exclusively for BAUST faculty and authority. Includes role-based access control, real-time order tracking, monthly billing, email notifications via Nodemailer, and a fully responsive dark-mode UI, tested with Vitest and deployed on Vercel.

title: Smart Campus Assistant Platform – AI University Management System
description: Led and architected a collaborative, hackathon-scale mini university management system built like a real software company, coordinating 8 specialized teams across AI, backend, frontend, mobile, UI/UX, QA, security, and data analysis. Delivered an AI chatbot for FAQs and deadlines, class schedules, notices, assignment reminders, and an analytics dashboard, with a companion Android app.

title: CSE Society, BAUST – Official Digital Platform
description: Designed and built the official web platform for the CSE Society at BAUST, featuring member registration, an admin dashboard, event and announcement feeds, group messaging, a digital constitution reader, and a dynamic poster generator, backed by Supabase authentication and data storage.

title: KenaKata.com – E-Commerce Website
description: Developed a full-featured e-commerce website using Laravel, PHP, MVC architecture, OOP, DbC, SOLID principles, and design patterns, with a focus on an intuitive and professional user interface.

title: DevVerse – Developer Community Platform
description: Built a developer-centric platform for collaboration, code sharing, and community building, empowering developers to share projects, discuss ideas, and enhance their coding skills.

title: JobMate Android App
description: An Android job portal app connecting job seekers with employers, developed using Java, Firebase, Android SDK, and XML.

title: Spell Checker (Word2Vec)
description: Developed an intelligent NLP-based spell checker using Word2Vec embeddings for context-aware spelling correction and word suggestions.

title: E-PATHSHALA – Full-Stack E-Learning Platform
description: Launched an online e-learning platform to make education more accessible, interactive, and engaging. Built with React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, and TailwindCSS.

title: E-PATHSHALA Mobile App
description: Mobile application version of the E-PATHSHALA platform built with Flutter and Dart, bringing e-learning to mobile devices.

title: Prohori - Android Crime Reporting & Missing Person Finder App
description: An Android-based application designed to assist in crime reporting and missing person identification. The app allows users to report incidents, upload missing person details, and collaborate with authorities through a centralized system. It integrates real-time data sharing, image handling, and user-friendly interfaces to improve public safety and response efficiency.

title: IoT Smart Drainage System
description: Developed a smart IoT-based drainage monitoring system to prevent urban flooding, integrating sensors, automation, and real-time monitoring.

title: BChat – Integrated Social Media & Cashless Digital Economy Platform
description: Designed and proposed a comprehensive social communication platform integrating messaging, services, and a unified digital payment ecosystem for Bangladesh.

title: DineMaster - A Restaurant Management System
description: A comprehensive restaurant management system built with PHP for handling orders, menu management, billing, and customer tracking.

title: Course Management System
description: A console-based C++ project for managing courses and student enrollment with file handling and OOP concepts.

title: ShobdoBondhu – Voice Controlled Robot
description: An Arduino-based robot integrating voice control and obstacle avoidance for smart navigation.

title: SmartPark – Smart Parking System
description: An Arduino-based smart parking system that detects slot availability in real-time using ultrasonic sensors and automates entry barriers.

title: Arduino Radar System
description: A radar system using Arduino and ultrasonic sensors to detect and map object positions in real-time.
